title.zh: 将宿务省第三与第四国会选区划为独立工程区并为其他目的法案
title.en: An Act Constituting the Third and Fourth Congressional Districts of the Province of Cebu into a Separate Engineering District, and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Constituting the Third and Fourth Congressional Districts of the Province of Cebu into a Separate Engineering District, and for Other Purposes

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1966/ra_4722_1966.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, the Third and Fourth Congressional District of the Province of Cebu are hereby constituted into a separate engineering district, to be known as the Fifth Engineering District of the Province of Cebu, with principal offices at the Municipality of Argao, same province.

The Secretary of Public Works and Communications is hereby authorized to appropriate the necessary sums, out of any unallotted funds and/or savings under the department, to carry into effect the provisions of this Act and to transfer the necessary personnel, records, property, equipment, and other supplies and materials, to carry out the provisions of this Act. Thereafter, the necessary sums for the purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1966.
